intro: Ask about leads, spend, speed to lead, the sales floor, AI or content. Answers come from the demo company's data.
suggestions: How did paid media do this week?
Which market has the lowest cost per set?
Which reps are below the floor?
What is the top objection on calls?
How accurate are the AI answers?
fallback: That one is outside this demo script. Try one of the suggestions.

entries.q: How did paid media do this week?
entries.answer:
Paid platform spend was **$47,331** over the last 7 days, flat on the week before.
Google Ads $26,194, Meta $15,833, Microsoft Ads $5,304.
All-in ad spend (media, agency fees and offline) was $59,986 against $266,135 of booked revenue.
follow_ups: What is our MER this week?

entries.q: Which campaign is the weakest?
entries.answer:
Over the last 14 days **NB Pro | Harborview | Search | Trade** (Google Ads) cost $118.51 per conversion on $3,072 of spend, the highest of any lead-generating campaign above $3,000. The best was NB | Regional | Retargeting at $14.29. Awareness video is left out of this ranking.
A pause or a budget cut here frees money for the winners.
follow_ups: Which market has the lowest cost per set?

entries.q: Which campaign is working best?
entries.answer: **NB | Regional | Retargeting** is the most efficient campaign over the last 14 days at $14.29 per conversion on $6,513 of spend.

entries.q: How many leads did we get yesterday?
entries.answer: **366 leads** yesterday, down 1% on the same day last week. 102 became set appointments and 10 became sales.
follow_ups: How is the funnel this week?

entries.q: What is our cost per lead?
entries.answer: Cost per lead is **$21.01** over the last 7 days (down 2% on the prior week), counting all ad spend over all leads.
follow_ups: What is our MER this week?

entries.q: What is our MER this week?
entries.answer: MER is **4.4x** over the last 7 days: $266,135 of revenue on $59,986 of ad spend. The prior week was 5.0x.

entries.q: Are we on pace this month?
entries.answer: Booked revenue is **$1,018,698** month to date against a monthly goal of $1,480,000. That is 89.0% of where the goal says we should be by today.

entries.q: How is the funnel this week?
entries.answer:
Last 7 days: **2,855 leads**, 788 sets, 569 issued appointments, 397 meetings held and **63 sales**.
Set rate 27.6% (28.7% the week before); close rate 15.9%.
follow_ups: What is the set rate by market?

entries.q: Which market has the lowest cost per set?
entries.answer:
Over the last 7 days **Sunvale** is the cheapest at $65 per set (74 sets) and **Harborview** the most expensive at $87.
Moving budget toward the cheaper market is the first lever.

entries.q: Which market closes best?
entries.answer: Over 28 days **Lakemont** closes best at 20.0% of meetings held, and Riverbend lowest at 15.5%. Company close rate is 17.1%.

entries.q: What is the set rate?
entries.answer: Set rate is **27.6%** over the last 7 days against 28.7% the week before. 788 appointments were set from 2,855 leads.
follow_ups: What is the connect rate on the floor?

entries.q: What is the connect rate on the floor?
entries.answer: The floor connected **13.7%** of 14,865 dials over the last 7 days (prior week 13.7%), with about 26 reps on each open day.
follow_ups: Which reps are below the floor?

entries.q: Which reps are below the floor?
entries.answer: The three lowest connect rates over 14 days: **Remy C.** 8.3% on 701 dials, **Nico F.** 8.8% on 624 dials, **Kendall J.** 8.9% on 586 dials. The floor average is 13.7%, so these are the coaching candidates.
follow_ups: What is the connect rate on the floor?

entries.q: Which source's leads close best?
entries.answer: Over 28 days **Referral** closes best at 24.3% of meetings held (337 meetings). The weakest is Microsoft Ads (Agency) at 9.4%.

entries.q: How is direct mail doing?
entries.answer: Over 28 days direct mail produced **624 leads** and 152 sets on $21,344 of spend, $140 per set. Responses land over the ten days after each Tuesday drop.

entries.q: How is regional TV doing?
entries.answer: Regional TV over 28 days: **468 leads**, 112 sets, $17,412 of spend, $155 per set. Four markets carry flights, four weeks on and one off.

entries.q: How is organic search doing?
entries.answer: Search Console clicks were **3,257** over the last 7 days, down 1% on the prior week, from 63,923 impressions. The top query was "roof replacement cost" with 530 clicks.
follow_ups: Which channels send the most web traffic?

entries.q: Which channels send the most web traffic?
entries.answer: Sessions over the last 7 days: **Organic Search** 11,766 (33%), **Paid Social** 9,523 (26%), **Paid Search** 5,742 (16%), out of 36,169 in total.

entries.q: How accurate are the AI answers?
entries.answer: Of 2,736 answers a reviewer graded in the last 7 days, **94.0%** were right. The AI answered 88.2% of 5,751 questions handed off 7.0% and declined 4.7%.

entries.q: What does the AI cost?
entries.answer: AI workloads made 55,318 calls in the last 7 days. At vendor list price that work would cost **$551**; it actually cost $193, a saving of $358. Month to date the saving is $1,192.

entries.q: How healthy are the loops?
entries.answer: The scheduled loops, agents and skills ran **2,247 times** in the last 7 days; 99.38% succeeded and 7 failed. One loop, the creative library sync, has not fired in two days and is flagged on the health page.

entries.q: Where are we against the marketing cost target?
entries.answer: All-in marketing cost is **28.0%** of net revenue this month against a target of 28%. Last month closed at 29.0%.

entries.q: Where does the month land?
entries.answer: Pacing the share of a month normally booked by today, the month lands near **$1.2M**, somewhere between $1.11M and $1.29M. The goal is $1.48M.
follow_ups: Are we on pace this month?

entries.q: What is in the content pipeline?
entries.answer: The library holds **32 pieces**: 6 approved, 13 in review and 13 in draft. The edit crew has 12 cuts in progress.

entries.q: Are there consent exceptions open?
entries.answer: Four consent items are open: one failed replay job, one capture held briefly, one failed text and one ambiguous stop waiting on a person. None is past its limit; the ambiguous stop is the one that needs a decision today.

entries.q: What is the top objection on calls?
entries.answer: **"I need to talk to my spouse"** came up on 256 of 2,034 connected calls this week and is trending up. Suggested response: offer a two-person estimate time and send the written summary to both of them the same day.

entries.q: How fast does the AI respond?
entries.answer: The median full answer takes **1.9 seconds** end to end over the last 7 days, inside the 3.5 second budget. Open knowledge gaps: 4.
follow_ups: How accurate are the AI answers?

entries.q: What changed this week?
entries.answer: Leads were down 2%, ad spend down 4% and revenue down 15%. MER moved from 5.0x to 4.4x. The floor connect rate held at 13.7%.
follow_ups: How did paid media do this week?
